prompt:
Create one abstract logo for TIDE. Exact text (copy verbatim, no other words): ''. Exact slogan: ''.
Render only the supplied exact text and nonempty slogan; the brand context is not additional lettering. Empty strings request no corresponding text.
Industry: Team scheduling and shift coordination SaaS. Audience: Operations coordinators and teammates in teams of 5–30 people.
Styles: abstract, substantial soft-cornered forms, calm, flexible, flat. Original brief palette context: #364A9F, #6591C4, #FFFFFF.
Avoid: lettering or initials, literal waves, clock, calendar, infinity sign. Use cases: 32px web-app sidebar symbol, service landing page.
Background: opaque. Produce a real PNG raster image. Use clean, readable shapes at small sizes; leave safe margins. Do not draw a transparency checkerboard, mockup, watermarks, or a concept grid.
Concept direction: For a small-team scheduling service, make a compact abstract handoff from exactly two substantial, low, soft-cornered forms offset diagonally: one upper left and one lower right. Their broad inward-facing ends fit across one short, clearly open diagonal white interval; the two forms do not touch and have no holes or enclosed loops. Use a restrained corner radius and slightly different lengths to give a settled but flexible rhythm, not two identical pills. Fill the upper-left form with deep blue-violet #364A9F and the lower-right form with supporting blue #6591C4. At 32px the two masses and the single central interval must remain distinct; the gesture must not turn into a wave, infinity sign, letter, clock or calendar. Center this one text-free symbol with clear margins on opaque pure #FFFFFF across the entire exterior canvas, including all four corners. Keep the mark flat, without a container, lighting, shadow or texture.. Assumptions: The 32px symbol is the primary stress case; the landing page may display the same master larger., Two unequal but related solid forms are the proposed visual interpretation of the supplied handoff direction..
Brand rendering: flat, front-facing product artwork by default; one clear idea, deliberate negative space and balanced optical weight. No paper texture, beige tint, presentation lighting, shadows or cinematic effects unless explicitly requested. Requested styles/concept override these surface defaults; depth and extra tones must obey the palette and gradient policy. Use the explicitly requested solid canvas or declared background role first; otherwise plain white #FFFFFF. User canvas and color/count requirements take precedence over this white fallback.
Logo construction: Build a nonliteral abstract mark around the concept's geometric or organic gesture, with coherent weight, deliberate openings and a memorable silhouette. Use style references for broad construction traits, not their brand words or traced signature shapes. The identity should remain recognizable in a one-color silhouette at the intended use size. This construction check does not replace the requested palette or request an extra monochrome image.
